description: This file defines the SearchQuery class which encapsulates search query parameters for the SuiteCRM search functionality. It includes methods for constructing search queries from strings, arrays, and GET requests, and provides methods to retrieve and manipulate search parameters like query string, size, offset, engine, and options.

classes.name: SearchQuery
classes.description: A class implementing a search query with properties such as query string, size, offset, engine, options, and modules. It provides several static methods to instantiate the class from different sources, as well as methods to access and modify its properties.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a SearchQuery object from a search string with optional pagination and engine parameters.

methods.name: fromRequestArray
methods.description: Creates a SearchQuery object from an array of request parameters, extracting search query, size, offset, engine, and modules.

methods.name: fromGetRequest
methods.description: Creates a SearchQuery object from the global GET parameters.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Returns the offset for search results pagination.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of results per page.

methods.name: getDefaultEngine
methods.description: Determines the default search engine based on the global configuration and request context.

methods.name: getDefaultSearchSize
methods.description: Determines the default search size based on configuration or a preset constant.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns the search engine used for this query.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Returns the value of a specified option key.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns all search options.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the search query string is empty.

methods.name: getSearchString
methods.description: Returns the search query string.

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.description: Converts the search query string to lowercase.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the start and end of the search query string.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces occurrences of a substring with another in the search query string.

methods.name: stripSlashes
methods.description: Removes backslashes from the search query string.

methods.name: escapeRegex
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in the search query string.

methods.name: convertEncoding
methods.description: Converts HTML entities in the query string into UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the search query object into an array for JSON encoding.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Returns the modules associated with this search query.
